steps.summary: Signed in to Odoo 17 as admin (session was already established from the replayed chain), navigated Sales → Orders → Customers, clicked New, set Company Type to Individual, filled Name "fwod11-n3 Bench Customer" and City "Benchville", and saved. The record persisted as res.partner id=46; after a full page reload the form still shows name "fwod11-n3 Bench Customer", city "Benchville", type "Individual".

Created and saved quotation S00021 (sale.order id=21) under Sales → Orders → Quotations → New. Customer was set by typing into the autocomplete and selecting the matching option "fwod11-n3 Bench Customer" (Benchville shown beside it). Exactly one order line was added by selecting "[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens" from the product autocomplete dropdown, with Quantity 3.00; the app auto-filled the Unit Price at £ 295.00 and computed the Untaxed Amount as £ 885.00 (TAX 20% £ 177.00, Total £ 1062.00). The record persisted — the URL shows id=21, the form is in read mode with breadcrumb S00021, and the saved form displays all these values.
